name: Cube Siege
author: Paycei
description: A complete 3D game mode, launched from MODS.EXE > Game Modes: survive six waves of cubes, drones and turrets in a first-person arena. Shows register.gamemode with base = "3d", the world3d library, entity AI, pickups, a shotgun tune, a custom HUD, draw3d effects and run.data.
